title: Extending Clean and Green Singapore Day Events to More Residents
what_it_is: Extending Clean and Green Singapore Day Events to More Residents

sections.label: Clean and Green Singapore Day 2025
sections.summary: NEA has no plans to set specific targets for its campaigns, whose objectives are to engage and shape public attitudes towards environmental sustainability.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment with respect to the projects and events for NEA's Clean and Green Singapore (CGS) Day 2025 (a) whether NEA will consider extending such projects and events islandwide to encourage more Singaporeans to adopt sustainable practices, conserve biodiversity, and foster a more gracious society; and (b) whether NEA intends to set targets and objectives for these projects and events.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: This year, it featured over 1,200 ground-up community events, workshops and activities organised at various locations island-wide, with or by partners, like the Public Hygiene Council and Community Development Councils, culminating in an annual CGS Day celebrating our collective environmental commitment.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Beyond CGS, Singaporeans can also participate in the other campaigns by the National Environment Agency (NEA), such as Clean Tables and Say Yes to Waste Less.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA has no plans to set specific targets for the campaigns, but the objectives are to engage and shape public attitudes towards environmental sustainability.

sections.label: Event and participant numbers
sections.summary: The number of events increased from 400 in 2023 to 1,200 in 2025, involving over 400,000 participants.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The number of events have increased, from 400 in 2023 to 1,200 in 2025, involving over 400,000 participants.

sections.label: SG Eco Fund and partnerships
sections.summary: The SG Eco Fund is one of several funding mechanisms, and partnerships are being developed with schools, educational institutions, NGOs and the private sector.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: The SG Eco Fund is one of several funding mechanisms and there are partnerships that we are developing with schools, educational institutions, NGOs and the private sector.

sections.label: Studying sustainability capability ideas
sections.summary: The capability to improve carbon footprint and increase sustainability will be increasingly needed across organisations, and ideas such as Ms Hany Soh's will continue to be studied.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: But actually, that is a skill – a capability – that we will increasingly need, across a variety of organisations, to be able to then improve our carbon footprint and increase our sustainability.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: So, we will continue to study ideas, such as the one that Ms Hany Soh has suggested.
